reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Secured lender exemption from property owner status
headings.reviewNote: Protects secured lenders holding ownership indicia without participating in management from owner or operator status.

headings.title: Lender-owner nonliability for pre-vesting contamination
headings.reviewNote: Shields lender-owners from liability for contamination pre-dating title vesting absent knowing or reckless conduct.

headings.title: Post-acquisition contamination liability limits and resale duty
headings.reviewNote: Limits lender-owner liability for ongoing ownership contamination during reasonable resale efforts and shields fiduciaries.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1991 enactment note; confirmed secured-lender non-owner status, pre-vesting contamination nonliability, and post-acquisition resale-effort limits and fiduciary protection.

headings.title: Notice of placement of collateral insurance
headings.reviewNote: Requires creditor to mail detailed statutory notice within thirty days of placing collateral protection insurance.

headings.title: Grace period extension and retroactive premium adjustments
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes creditor grace periods of sixty days or more with amended cancellation terms for retroactive coverage.

headings.title: Repayment terms for insurance costs
headings.reviewNote: Specifies permissible repayment structures including lump-sum, full loan amortization, or balloon payments.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections (including verbatim Notice of Placement of Insurance) and 1997/1998 history note; confirmed 30-day placement notice, 60-day grace period/retroactive premium, and repayment options.

headings.title: Mandatory cancellation upon proof of substitute insurance
headings.reviewNote: Mandates cancellation of unilateral collateral protection coverage whenever debtor maintains substitute insurance meeting agreement requirements and provides proper evidence.

headings.title: Cancellation without charge upon timely proof of coverage
headings.reviewNote: Requires cancelling collateral protection coverage without charging premiums, interest, or other costs if debtor proves continuous coverage within thirty days of notice.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1997 enactment note; edited both titles and notes to remove unstated pro-rata/refund claims and match mandatory cancellation on substitute insurance proof and no-charge cancellation within 30 days.

headings.title: Parity in depository institution insurance commissions
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits restricting commissions to licensed institution employees or agents beyond restrictions on unaffiliated third parties.

headings.title: Parity in inter-entity contractual consideration
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits restricting contractual consideration between depository institutions and related entities for insurance sales.

headings.title: Preservation of regulatory safety and soundness authority
headings.reviewNote: Preserves finance division regulatory and enforcement authority over institutional safety and soundness.

headings.title: Definitions of statutory terms
headings.reviewNote: Defines statutory terms including commissions, depository institution, and related entity.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all four subsections and 2001 enactment note; confirmed depository-institution commission parity (excluding ch. 385 credit insurance), fair-market-value inter-entity consideration, regulatory safety/soundness powers, and definitions.

headings.title: Deceptive notification or solicitation using institution name
headings.reviewNote: Defines deceptive practices involving unauthorized use of financial institution names in notifications or solicitations.

headings.title: False institution endorsement or consumer-data source claims
headings.reviewNote: Defines deceptive use to include falsely stating or implying endorsement by a named financial institution or falsely stating consumer data came from a third-party institution.

headings.title: Civil action, minimum damages, and attorney fees
headings.reviewNote: Permits a private civil action by the affected financial institution for $10,000 minimum recovery, court costs, attorney fees, and any damages proved at trial.

headings.title: Definition of financial institution
headings.reviewNote: Defines financial institution to include banks, credit unions, mortgage bankers, and consumer finance lenders.

headings.title: Preservation of attorney general enforcement authority
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that private remedies do not bar attorney general enforcement under merchandising practices laws.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all five subsections and 2004/2008 history note; replaced hallucinated loan-transfer heading/note in subsection 2 with false institution endorsement/consumer-data source claims, removed unstated injunction reference in subsection 3 note, and confirmed remaining headings.

headings.title: Title of commercial financing disclosure law
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the short title as the Commercial Financing Disclosure Law.

headings.title: Definitions of statutory terms
headings.reviewNote: Defines terms including account, broker, commercial financing, provider, and accounts receivable purchase transaction.

headings.title: Mandatory disclosure of commercial financing terms
headings.reviewNote: Requires providers to disclose total financing amount, disbursement, schedule, finance charge, and prepayment terms.

headings.title: Exempt entities and financing transactions
headings.reviewNote: Exempts depository institutions, service corporations, Farm Credit Act lenders, real-property/lease/purchase-money deals, >=$50k auto/rental deals, healthcare factoring, money transmitters, <=5/yr providers, >$500k deals, and premium finance agreements.

headings.title: Commercial financing broker registration and bond
headings.reviewNote: Requires brokers to register with division of finance, pay fees, and maintain ten-thousand dollar surety bond.

headings.title: Civil fines and attorney general enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes five-hundred dollar civil fines per incident, repeat offender enhancements, and attorney general enforcement.

headings.title: Effective date contingent on rule promulgation
headings.reviewNote: Establishes effective date six months after division rules are finalized or on February 28, 2025 if no rules are promulgated.

headings.title: Division of finance rulemaking authority
headings.reviewNote: Permits division of finance rulemaking (intent deadline Feb. 28, 2025) subject to chapter 536 nonseverability voiding rules after August 28, 2024.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all eight subsections and 2024/2025 history note; retained titles, corrected subsection 4 note (removing unstated ch. 367 reference), and documented August 28, 2024 chapter 536 nonseverability clause in subsection 8.
